text: Been decades since I programmed PCs as a hobby...but in any case, I assume it is possible that, depending on the dimensions of the monitor (aspect ratio), that if the screen saver places the icon in the same place on the screen when it first starts (or within a particular region of the screen), that the rebounding movement of the icon may not be able to pass over the entire screen (such as missing the corners), because the angle of impact must equal the angle of the rebound. The way to fix this (so the corners could be hit) would be to have the icon placed randomly on the screen when the screen saver first begins and to give it a random direction of movement.
